text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ――Now then. Let's finish this.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hmph! Haaaaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...!! I... can too... Nnngh... Uuuugh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“The winner is Gentildonna!! Crowned Queen 
of the Cherry Blossoms! It's 
Gentildonnaaaa!!”

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Yes.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I have received it without fail. The tiara 
meant for me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Now then... Just two more.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Oooooooh...!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
So it was Gentildonna after all...! 
Looking back, it makes total sense...

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Right?! I knew she'd be super strong! ...I 
mean, I thought she would, but...

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
That was beyond anything I imagined. The 
sheer intensity was on a whole different 
level from the other girls...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, so frustrating!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I never imagined Big Sis could actually 
lose...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Big sis was strong too. But... her 
opponent was just too strong."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Still. This isn't the end... right?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Big sis...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Phew... phew...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I knew it... It's you, isn't it...! The 
one standing in my path...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hmph! Haaaaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...No... n-no!! I'm perfectly fine...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "It's okay. Because I am...!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I am so sorry, Trainer. ...I lost.
choice_data_list: You were strong too. It's just—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I understand.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...The one who won was just stronger than 
that."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I am frustrated. To have exposed such an 
unsightly display to my little sisters."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "It's just so... ngh, frustrating...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina fell silent, trembling. However, 
in the very next moment—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She had regained a fiery confidence.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'll become stronger than I am now... and 
I will definitely repay this humiliation!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
The upcoming Oaks is a race that I, of all 
people, must win.
choice_data_list:
It's what you've been aiming for all this 
time, after all!

It's what you've been aiming for all this 
time, right!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the Oaks from the very 
beginning, she has trained up to this 
point keeping the Tokyo Racecourse track 
and the longer distance firmly in mind.
choice_data_list:
(The rivals are tough, that's for sure, 
but……)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as Verxina thought, Gentildonna is a 
formidable threat. However, if it's 
her...!
choice_data_list: We have to win the Oaks, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
This time for sure, I shall lead the way 
for my younger sisters...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Knock knock...)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big siiis...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Hey.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Listen! Sis, you were super cool out 
there! So...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I made you worry. I'm sorry, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: If it's you, big sis, you'll be fine!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You know, don't you? Just how strong I 
really am.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ! Big Sis...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, mhm. That's right, you'll be just 
fine, Sis!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Because, because, you're prettier and 
cooler than anyone else♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Believe in me once more. Next time, I 
will not betray your expectations."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"At the Oaks, this time for sure! I'll 
show you... just how strong I am!"
